subject: Request: One-off portfolio reprice & packaging exception for AsterBio (VP/CFO signoff)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: AsterBio — ask for one-off reprice & packaging exception

Team,

Quick summary: AsterBio is pushing to close next week. Current proposed ARR is $1,800,000 (12-month). Procurement has signaled they will go to a competitor unless we (a) move to an upfront 12% trade discount on list pricing and (b) remove the dedicated onboarding support seats from the package (they want a lean bundle). They are sensitive to TCO and will sign an MSA with our standard terms otherwise.

Request: I need an exception approval to offer a one-time portfolio reprice (effective only for this contract) of 42% off standard list on the inference component for the first year plus removal of the 3 dedicated onboarding seats (we'll keep self-serve onboarding docs + two onboarding calls). Margin impact estimate is in the attached pricing-model_RX4938.xlsx and the commercial proposal AsterBio_MA_proposal_v3.pdf.

Why now: Competitive bake-off revealed pricing gap; AsterBio is top-tier prospect (biology data platform, funding Series D). If we lose to price this quarter we likely lose all future enterprise pipeline in this vertical.

Ask: VP/CFO signoff required for an exception at 42% and for the one-off packaging change. Recommend signoff only if we keep: 12-month paid term, 60-day irrevocable cancellation notice, and Net 30 payment (no additional credit).

Attachments: AsterBio_MA_proposal_v3.pdf, pricing-model_RX4938.xlsx

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AsterBio — ask for one-off reprice & packaging exception

Logan —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. Two quick things I need before I can recommend upward:
1) Break down of expected blended unit economics on the discounted plan (tokens per month estimate + expected KV cache hit assumptions). I want to ensure we're not below our break-even after infra and support.
2) Precedent note: have we given a similar depth of reprice (>40%) to other Series D prospects recently? If so, who and what guardrails were applied?

If you can send the simplified margin table and a short precedent note we can move to Markus & finance.

-Marissa
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AsterBio — ask for one-off reprice & packaging exception

Marissa —

Attached: pricing-model_RX4938.xlsx has the blended economics tab (tab: margin-summary). Snapshot:
- Forecasted avg monthly tokens: 1.2B generation tokens, 150M embedding tokens (month 3–12 ramp).
- Estimated infra cost (gpu + network + storage): ~$32k/month at discounted run rate.
- Support + success overhead (reduced onboarding seats): ~$6k/month.
- At 42% discount, annualized gross margin ~38% on year-1 revenue; lifetime (year 2+) margin recovers to ~55% if list pricing resumes.

Precedent: We offered a 40% one-off on Helix (Series C) last Q, with a clause that prevented stacking with other promos. That had an approval memo and required VP+Finance signoff. I recommend the same guardrails: one-time, non-stackable, CFO must initial the redline on the quote.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/RX-4938
DocuSign preview (draft): https://docusign.com/Tx/abc123-AsterBio-quote

I'll prepare an exec memo to send to CFO for signature if you confirm we have runway to accept the margin hit.

— Logan

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AsterBio — ask for one-off reprice & packaging exception

Team,

I reviewed the attachment and the precedent Logan mentioned. My view: strategic value justifies an exception, provided we lock the following in the commercial terms:
- 12-month minimum committed ARR (paid annually)
- Non-stackable one-time renewal option at list pricing only
- No SLAs beyond standard hosted API (we explicitly exclude Dedicated guarantees)

Please prep an internal exception memo for CFO signature that includes: deal rationale, margin hit table, precedent list, and recommended constraints. I'll sign off as VP Sales if CFO gives the financial clearance.

-Markus
VP Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AsterBio — ask for one-off reprice & packaging exception

Markus & team —

I reviewed the margin-summary and ran a quick stress test on usage ramp. Finance is willing to recommend CFO approval under these guardrails: 1) upfront payment for year-1 with Net 30, 2) a 90-day usage audit clause (we reserve right to bill for overages if token usage materially exceeds forecast), and 3) explicit language that the discount applies only to the inference SKU for year 1.

I'm attaching the redwood-exception-form.pdf with the finance checklist filled out. If Markus signs the internal memo I'll route to CFO for the final signoff.

-Grace
Head of Partnerships & Finance Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-exception-form.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@asterbio.com>, James Turner <james.turner@asterbio.com>, AsterBio Procurement <procurement@asterbio.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final commercial terms — AsterBio (pending CFO signature)

Susan & James —

Thanks again for the productive conversations. Attached is the revised commercial proposal (AsterBio_MA_proposal_v3.pdf) showing the one-time discounted inference rate for year 1 (42% off list) and the streamlined onboarding package. This offer is contingent on internal executive approval (we expect signoff from our CFO within 48 hours).

Key terms included in the attached:
- Term: 12 months, paid upfront (Net 30)
- Discount: 42% one-time on inference SKU for year 1 only
- Onboarding: 2 live onboarding calls + documentation (dedicated seats removed)
- Audit clause: 90-day usage audit with overage billing if usage exceeds forecast by >35%
- Non-stackable, one-off exception; future renewals at list pricing unless otherwise negotiated

I'll circle back as soon as I have the CFO signature. Appreciate your patience — we prioritized keeping your launch date intact.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
